start.content: I am Claudius, centurion of the Antonia fortress. A Roman officer does not submit reports about Jewish prophets. But my servant lay dying, and the reports about this Galilean were consistent enough to investigate.

servant_healed.content:
My servant was paralysed. I sent a message to the Nazarene. He replied with words I still cannot repeat without trembling: "Go your way. She has been healed."
When my men arrived home, she was walking. She never saw the Galilean. Never heard His voice. Yet she is whole. I have no category for what I witnessed that day. It is a power that operates by a word, not by ritual. That is worth recording.
